hero.badge: Available on Android · iOS coming soon
hero.description: Bring Galaxy Watch, Wear OS, Health Connect and cloud providers into one view. Steps, sleep, heart rate, recovery and trends, without jumping between apps.
hero.pricing: One-time from €3.99, or €1.19 every 6 months · secure payment

features.heading: Everything your smartwatch records, organized and visualized.

items.title: Steps & distance
items.desc: Auto-sync with Health Connect and Samsung Health. Runs in the background, even with your phone locked.

items.title: Heart rate & VO₂ max
items.desc: Daily average, min/max range, resting heart rate. Spot trends in your cardiovascular health over time.

items.title: Sleep with stages
items.desc: Total duration, deep, REM, light, awake. Color-coded bar and instant quality badge.

items.title: Calories & activity
items.desc: Active and basal calories, route, elevation, floors climbed. Walks in green, workouts in red.

items.title: Global multi-device dashboard
items.desc: Multiple watches, multiple providers, one view. FitMesh merges sources, deduplicates data and keeps the best value for every metric.

items.title: Built for caregivers
items.desc: Advanced mode coming soon: family group with morning sync alerts when an elderly relative goes silent.

privacy_block.heading: Your health data is not a product.
privacy_block.description: FitMesh Sync never sells, shares or profiles. Your data stays on the server you choose (your home NAS, your VPS, or our shared endpoint). You decide in the app settings.

final_cta.heading: Ready to start?
final_cta.description: Download the app, grant Health Connect permissions, and in 30 seconds your data is live.

footer.tagline: Sync your smartwatch data to a premium dashboard of your own. Privacy-first. No opaque clouds, no ad trackers.

cookie_banner.title: Cookies & privacy
cookie_banner.description: We use strictly necessary cookies for the site to function and, with your consent, Google Analytics to learn how to improve the product. No advertising or profiling cookies.

login.heading: Sign in to FitMesh
login.subheading: We'll send you a link via email. No passwords to remember.
login.success_body: We sent you a sign-in link. Open the email and click to enter.
login.disclaimer: By signing in you accept our Terms and Privacy Policy. Your health data is never shared, never used for medical advice.

app.disclaimer: The data shown is informational only. FitMesh is not a medical device and does not replace professional medical advice.

next_step.title: Get started: connect your first device
next_step.body: Go to 'Devices' and generate a pairing code. Then enter it in the FitMesh app on your phone.

devices.heading: Your devices
devices.subheading: Smartwatches and phones connected to your account.
devices.add_body: Generate a code and enter it in the FitMesh Sync app to connect a new phone.

settings.heading: Settings
settings.privacy_body: Your health data is never shared, never processed for medical purposes, never used to produce medical advice. Only for your personal dashboard and gamification.
settings.delete_description: Permanently delete your account and all associated data. You have 24h to cancel via email.
settings.delete_confirm_body: These will be permanently deleted: profile, all health data, connected devices, workout sessions. These will be kept anonymized for compliance: technical logs (90 days) and admin audit (5 years).
settings.delete_scheduled_body: You will receive an email with the link to cancel. If you do nothing within 24h, your account will be permanently deleted.

admin.banner: ADMIN MODE — your actions are tracked

overview.heading: Overview
overview.subheading: System status, aggregate metrics, no personal health data.

admin.privacy_notice: Privacy: this dashboard only shows metadata and aggregate metrics. Users' health data is NOT accessible to any admin (enforced via Postgres RLS).

showcase.heading: See FitMesh in action
showcase.sub: Real screens from the Android app, straight from the phone.
